title: 聚焦離子束分析系統
summary: 從 30 keV 鎵離子在固體中的碰撞串級出發，理解聚焦離子束如何以奈米精度移除與沉積材料，再把離子源、靜電離子柱、SEM／FIB 雙束幾何、TEM 薄片的非晶化與鎵植入、束流與切削速率校正以及切片斷層重建整合成可交接的分析工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Start from the collision cascade of 30 keV gallium ions in a solid to see how a focused ion beam removes and deposits material with nanometre precision, then integrate the ion source, electrostatic ion column, SEM/FIB dual-beam geometry, amorphisation and gallium implantation in TEM lamellae, beam-current and milling-rate calibration and slice-and-view tomography into a transferable analytical engineering record.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: TEM 薄片製程預算練習（矽，0.275 µm³/nC）：兩側粗切溝槽各 15 × 8 × 6 µm，共 1440 µm³，需 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC，以 9 nA 約 9.7 分鐘；把 2 µm 厚的薄片在 15 × 6 µm 範圍減薄到 0.5 µm，移除 135 µm³ 需 491 nC，以 1 nA 約 8.2 分鐘；最後在 10 × 5 µm 視窗由 0.5 µm 減到 0.1 µm，移除 20 µm³ 需 72.7 nC，以 0.1 nA 約 12 分鐘，30 kV 切削合計約 30 分鐘。若只以 30 kV 收尾到 60 nm，每側 22 nm 非晶層讓結晶核心只剩 16 nm；加做 5 kV 與 2 kV 清潔後每側約 2.5 nm，核心 55 nm（92%）。若精修光闌實際束流比標示低 8% 而未校正，最後一步只移除 18.4 µm³，薄片停在約 0.13 µm，需要額外 1 分鐘補切。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: TEM-lamella process budget for silicon at 0.275 µm³/nC: two rough trenches of 15 × 8 × 6 µm total 1440 µm³ and need 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC, about 9.7 minutes at 9 nA; thinning the 2 µm lamella over 15 × 6 µm to 0.5 µm removes 135 µm³ with 491 nC, about 8.2 minutes at 1 nA; finally thinning a 10 × 5 µm window from 0.5 to 0.1 µm removes 20 µm³ with 72.7 nC, about 12 minutes at 0.1 nA, for about 30 minutes of 30 kV milling in all. Finishing at 30 kV only to 60 nm leaves 22 nm of amorphous material per face and a crystalline core of just 16 nm; adding 5 kV and 2 kV cleaning brings each face to about 2.5 nm and the core to 55 nm (92%). If the polishing aperture delivers 8% less than its label without correction, the last step removes only 18.4 µm³ and the lamella stops near 0.13 µm, needing about one more minute of milling. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。鎵在矽中的投射射程約 27 nm，橫向散布約 10 nm，所以切削的最小尺度與損傷深度都由此決定。濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth. Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設 30 keV Ga⁺ 正向入射矽的濺射產率 Y = 2.2 原子/離子，矽原子體積 Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³：每 nC 電荷移除體積 = (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming a sputter yield Y = 2.2 atoms per ion for 30 keV Ga⁺ at normal incidence on silicon and an atomic volume Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³, the volume removed per nanocoulomb is (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設 30 keV Ga⁺ 正向入射矽的濺射產率 Y = 2.2 原子/離子，矽原子體積 Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³：每 nC 電荷移除體積 = (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC。切一個 20 × 10 × 10 µm（2000 µm³）的截面方塊需 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC，以 30 nA 約 243 s ≈ 4 分鐘（未計再沉積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming a sputter yield Y = 2.2 atoms per ion for 30 keV Ga⁺ at normal incidence on silicon and an atomic volume Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³, the volume removed per nanocoulomb is (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC. A 20 × 10 × 10 µm (2000 µm³) cross-section box needs 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC, about 243 s or 4 minutes at 30 nA before redeposition is counted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces. steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束限光闌與離子探針光點」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。液態金屬離子源的能量散布約 5 eV，在小束流時色差主導，色差盤 d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E 與收斂半角 α 成正比，而束流 I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) 與 α² 成正比，所以光點約隨 √I 成長；到 nA 等級時球差與源像放大接手，光點擴大到數百 nm。工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres. A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。束流多 11 倍，色差盤大 3.3 倍，符合 d ∝ √I。若要以 3 nm 光點切 1 µm³ 需 3.6 nC，在 5.7 pA 要 10.5 分鐘，因此粗切與精修必須分開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm. Eleven times the current costs 3.3 times the chromatic disc, consistent with d ∝ √I. Removing 1 µm³ with the 3 nm probe needs 3.6 nC, or 10.5 minutes at 5.7 pA, which is why roughing and polishing are separated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 液態金屬離子源與靜電離子柱：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Liquid-metal ion source and electrostatic ion column: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鎵液態金屬離子源與靜電透鏡」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gallium LMIS and electrostatic lenses” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鎵液態金屬離子源是一根尖端半徑數 µm 的鎢針，由儲槽中的液態鎵潤濕；萃取電極施加數 kV 電壓，強電場把液面拉成泰勒錐，錐尖只有數 nm，在約 10 V/nm 的場下發生場蒸發而放出 Ga⁺。鎵熔點 29.8 °C、蒸氣壓低、質量適中，是最常用的源材料。離子柱由萃取極、抑制極、聚光鏡、束限光闌條、遮斷器、八極偏轉／消像散器與物鏡組成，全部使用靜電透鏡，因為重離子的磁剛度比同能量電子大數百倍，磁透鏡難以聚焦。氙電漿 FIB 則以感應耦合電漿源取代液態金屬，沒有鎵污染並可給出 µA 束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎵液態金屬離子源與靜電透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gallium liquid-metal ion source is a tungsten needle with an apex radius of a few micrometres wetted by liquid gallium from a reservoir; an extractor several kilovolts away pulls the liquid into a Taylor cone whose tip is only a few nanometres across, where a field near 10 V/nm field-evaporates Ga⁺. Gallium's 29.8 °C melting point, low vapour pressure and moderate mass make it the usual choice. The column consists of extractor, suppressor, condenser lens, beam-defining aperture strip, blanker, octupole deflector/stigmator and objective lens, all electrostatic, because a heavy ion's magnetic rigidity is hundreds of times that of an electron of the same energy and magnetic lenses cannot focus it efficiently. A xenon plasma FIB replaces the liquid metal with an inductively coupled plasma source, avoiding gallium contamination and delivering microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gallium LMIS and electrostatic lenses”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Magnetic rigidity is Bρ = p/q: for 30 keV Ga⁺, p = √(2mE) ≈ 3.34×10⁻²⁰ kg·m/s and Bρ ≈ 0.208 T·m, while a relativistic 30 keV electron has Bρ ≈ 5.9×10⁻⁴ T·m, about 350 times smaller.

steps.title: 雙束幾何、束誘發沉積與偵測器：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 雙束系統把垂直的 SEM 柱與傾斜 52°（Thermo Fisher）或 54°（ZEISS）的 FIB 柱對準在同一個共焦點，平台傾到該角度時離子束垂直切入表面，SEM 則從斜上方觀察剛切出的截面，所以截面上的垂直尺寸被縮短為 sin θ 倍。氣體注入系統把有機金屬或碳氫前驅物噴到表面，由電子或離子束分解成鉑、鎢或碳的保護層與導線；電子束沉積不傷表面但慢，離子束沉積快但含鎵與碳並會破壞最上層。偵測器包含 Everhart–Thornley、柱內二次電子與背散射電子、離子誘發二次電子（晶粒通道對比），以及 EDS、EBSD 與微操作器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dual-beam system aligns the vertical SEM column and an FIB column tilted at 52° (Thermo Fisher) or 54° (ZEISS) on one coincident point; with the stage tilted to that angle the ion beam mills perpendicular to the surface while the SEM views the freshly cut face obliquely, so vertical dimensions in the cross-section are foreshortened by sin θ. Detectors include Everhart–Thornley, in-column secondary and backscattered electron detectors, ion-induced secondary electrons with grain-channelling contrast, plus EDS, EBSD and a micromanipulator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coincident point, gas-injection needles and detectors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平台傾斜 52° 時 SEM 看到的截面高度 = 真實高度 × sin 52° = 0.788 倍，影像上量到 158 nm 的膜層實際為 158/0.788 ≈ 200 nm；若傾角誤差 0.5°，sin 52.5°/sin 52° = 1.0068，厚度誤差 0.7%。

steps.title: 雙束幾何、束誘發沉積與偵測器：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平台傾斜 52° 時 SEM 看到的截面高度 = 真實高度 × sin 52° = 0.788 倍，影像上量到 158 nm 的膜層實際為 158/0.788 ≈ 200 nm；若傾角誤差 0.5°，sin 52.5°/sin 52° = 1.0068，厚度誤差 0.7%。共焦高度偏離 Δz = 5 µm 時，傾斜 52° 會讓兩束影像相對錯開 Δz·sin 52° ≈ 3.9 µm，足以讓 FIB 切到目標旁邊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the stage tilted 52°, the SEM sees cross-section heights multiplied by sin 52° = 0.788, so a layer measuring 158 nm in the image is really 158/0.788 ≈ 200 nm; a 0.5° tilt error gives sin 52.5°/sin 52° = 1.0068, a 0.7% thickness error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.objective: 說明「TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 提取法製備 TEM 薄片的流程是：保護層、兩側粗切溝槽、底切、以微操作器焊接取出、轉移到銅格，再以逐步降低的束流與 1–2° 過傾角補償束流錐度把薄片減薄到 100 nm 以下，高解析觀察常需 20–50 nm。每一道離子都會在兩側表面留下厚度約等於射程的非晶損傷層並植入鎵，所以最後以 5 kV 與 2 kV 低能量離子清潔，把損傷層從二十幾 nm 降到數 nm。減薄終點以 SEM 低能量影像判斷，電子穿透時二次電子對比改變；實際厚度則以 TEM 的 EELS 對數比法量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lift-out preparation of a TEM lamella proceeds through a protective cap, rough trenches on both sides, an undercut, attachment and extraction with a micromanipulator, transfer to a copper grid, and thinning with stepwise lower currents and a 1–2° over-tilt that compensates the beam taper until the lamella is below 100 nm, often 20–50 nm for high-resolution work. The thinning end-point is judged from low-voltage SEM images whose secondary-electron contrast changes once electrons transmit, and the actual thickness is measured in the TEM by the EELS log-ratio method. steps.title: TEM 薄片製備的厚度與損傷預算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TEM lamella and amorphous damage layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設每側非晶層在 30 kV 為 22 nm、5 kV 為 6 nm、2 kV 為 2.5 nm。60 nm 薄片若只用 30 kV 收尾，結晶核心僅 60 − 2×22 = 16 nm（27%）；5 kV 清潔後為 48 nm（80%）；2 kV 清潔後為 55 nm（92%）。EELS 量得 t/λ = 0.40、矽在 200 kV 的非彈性平均自由徑假設 λ ≈ 150 nm，則厚度 t = 0.40 × 150 = 60 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume an amorphous layer per face of 22 nm at 30 kV, 6 nm at 5 kV and 2.5 nm at 2 kV. A 60 nm lamella finished only at 30 kV keeps a crystalline core of 60 − 2×22 = 16 nm (27%); after 5 kV cleaning it is 48 nm (80%) and after 2 kV cleaning 55 nm (92%). With an EELS t/λ = 0.40 and an assumed inelastic mean free path λ ≈ 150 nm for silicon at 200 kV, the thickness is t = 0.40 × 150 = 60 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.instruction: 製作兩片對照薄片：一片只用 30 kV、一片加做 5 kV 與 2 kV 清潔，在 TEM 以高解析影像量側壁非晶層厚度，並以 EELS 厚度圖檢查整片的厚度均勻度；以 EDS 或 EELS 量薄片表面的鎵訊號，比較兩種流程的鎵殘留；把 SEM 判斷的終點與 EELS 厚度對照，建立此材料的終點對比表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: FIB 交給圖形的劑量是束流乘以時間，而實際束流會隨源老化、光闌磨損與聚光鏡設定而偏離標示值，所以每個光闌都要以法拉第杯量測並記錄。切削深度還取決於材料的產率表與入射角，SEM 量測又取決於像素尺寸校正與傾斜修正；長時間圖形化期間的熱漂移與帶電漂移，則以表面上的基準標記做影像相關修正。這些項目一起構成截面量測與終點判斷的不確定度預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：標示 1.00 nA 的光闌以法拉第杯量得 0.92 nA。在矽上切 2 × 2 × 1 µm（4 µm³）方塊，依標示值設定 4/0.275 ≈ 14.5 nC、時間 14.5 s；實際劑量 14.5 × 0.92 ≈ 13.4 nC，只移除 3.68 µm³，深度 0.92 µm，短少 8%。SEM 在 52° 下看到 0.725 µm，除以 0.788 得 0.920 µm，與預測一致。漂移 5 nm/min、圖形化 10 分鐘則累積 50 nm 位置誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An aperture labelled 1.00 nA measures 0.92 nA on the Faraday cup. Milling a 2 × 2 × 1 µm (4 µm³) box in silicon with the labelled value sets 4/0.275 ≈ 14.5 nC and 14.5 s, but the real dose is 14.5 × 0.92 ≈ 13.4 nC, removing only 3.68 µm³ to a depth of 0.92 µm, 8% short. The SEM at 52° sees 0.725 µm, and dividing by 0.788 gives 0.920 µm, matching the prediction. A 5 nm/min drift over 10 minutes of patterning accumulates a 50 nm placement error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每天以法拉第杯量所有常用光闌的束流並與歷史趨勢比較，偏差超過 5% 即更新劑量表；每週在矽上切標準方塊並以截面量深度驗證 µm³/nC；以節距標準片校正 SEM 與離子影像的像素尺寸；長時間工作時每 2–5 分鐘以基準標記量漂移並由軟體自動修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the current of every frequently used aperture on the Faraday cup daily and compare with its history, updating the dose table when the deviation exceeds 5%; mill a standard box in silicon weekly and verify µm³/nC from the cross-section depth; calibrate SEM and ion-image pixel sizes on a pitch standard; during long jobs measure drift on a fiducial every 2–5 minutes and let the software correct it automatically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Milling a 2 × 2 × 1 µm (4 µm³) box in silicon with the labelled value sets 4/0.275 ≈ 14.5 nC and 14.5 s, but the real dose is 14.5 × 0.92 ≈ 13.4 nC, removing only 3.68 µm³ to a depth of 0.92 µm, 8% short. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Calibrating beam current, milling rate and dimensions", which statement holds?

steps.title: 束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calibrating beam current, milling rate and dimensions: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Faraday cup, calibration box and fiducial mark” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每天以法拉第杯量所有常用光闌的束流並與歷史趨勢比較，偏差超過 5% 即更新劑量表；每週在矽上切標準方塊並以截面量深度驗證 µm³/nC；以節距標準片校正 SEM 與離子影像的像素尺寸；長時間工作時每 2–5 分鐘以基準標記量漂移並由軟體自動修正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the current of every frequently used aperture on the Faraday cup daily and compare with its history, updating the dose table when the deviation exceeds 5%; mill a standard box in silicon weekly and verify µm³/nC from the cross-section depth; calibrate SEM and ion-image pixel sizes on a pitch standard; during long jobs measure drift on a fiducial every 2–5 minutes and let the software correct it automatically. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：依標示束流與時間切到某金屬層的終點，實際束流低 8% 讓切削停在目標上方而誤判為斷線，或束流偏高時切穿目標層；未做漂移修正的長時間圖形化讓多層截面的各階段錯位，量到的線寬與間距混入數十 nm 的假偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Cutting to a metal layer by labelled current and time stops 8% short of the target when the real current is low, which is misread as an open circuit, or punches through the target when the current is high; long patterning without drift correction misregisters successive stages of a multilayer cross-section, adding false deviations of tens of nanometres to measured widths and spacings.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每天以法拉第杯量所有常用光闌的束流並與歷史趨勢比較，偏差超過 5% 即更新劑量表；每週在矽上切標準方塊並以截面量深度驗證 µm³/nC；以節距標準片校正 SEM 與離子影像的像素尺寸；長時間工作時每 2–5 分鐘以基準標記量漂移並由軟體自動修正。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

截面厚度可以直接從 SEM 影像讀出，不必做傾斜修正。

optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Cross-section thickness can be read straight from the SEM image without tilt correction.
Measure the current of every frequently used aperture on the Faraday cup daily and compare with its history, updating the dose table when the deviation exceeds 5%.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the current of every frequently used aperture on the Faraday cup daily and compare with its history, updating the dose table when the deviation exceeds 5%; mill a standard box in silicon weekly and verify µm³/nC from the cross-section depth; calibrate SEM and ion-image pixel sizes on a pitch standard; during long jobs measure drift on a fiducial every 2–5 minutes and let the software correct it automatically. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calibrating beam current, milling rate and dimensions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Faraday cup, calibration box and fiducial mark” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 依標示束流與時間切到某金屬層的終點，實際束流低 8% 讓切削停在目標上方而誤判為斷線，或束流偏高時切穿目標層；未做漂移修正的長時間圖形化讓多層截面的各階段錯位，量到的線寬與間距混入數十 nm 的假偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting to a metal layer by labelled current and time stops 8% short of the target when the real current is low, which is misread as an open circuit, or punches through the target when the current is high; long patterning without drift correction misregisters successive stages of a multilayer cross-section, adding false deviations of tens of nanometres to measured widths and spacings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些項目一起構成截面量測與終點判斷的不確定度預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Together these items form the uncertainty budget of cross-section metrology and end-point decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光闌標示的束流值就是實際打到樣品上的束流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The current printed on an aperture is the current actually reaching the sample." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合」與「系統驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration" and "System acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「切片—成像循環與體素」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切片斷層把 FIB 切一層、SEM 拍一張的循環重複數百到數千次，重建出奈米解析度的三維體積，並可同步取得 EDS 成分或 EBSD 晶向。系統整合的關鍵是：切片厚度要等於或接近影像像素以得到等向體素，SEM 影像在傾斜下的 y 方向需做 1/sin θ 修正，整段數小時的漂移要靠基準標記追蹤，而離子源穩定度、帶電與簾幕效應會在整個體積中留下系統誤差。資料量與時間預算也必須在開始前算好，否則實驗會在半途因儲存或源壽命而中斷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「切片—成像循環與體素」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slice-and-view tomography repeats a cycle of one FIB slice and one SEM image hundreds to thousands of times to reconstruct a nanometre-resolution volume, optionally with simultaneous EDS composition or EBSD orientation. The integration keys are a slice thickness equal or close to the image pixel for isotropic voxels, a 1/sin θ correction of the tilted SEM image's y axis, fiducial tracking of drift over many hours, and awareness that source stability, charging and curtaining leave systematic errors throughout the volume. The data volume and time budget must be calculated before starting, or the run stops halfway on storage or source life. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：體積 20 × 20 × 10 µm、切片 10 nm 共 1000 層；每張 SEM 影像 2048 × 1536 像素、每像素 3 µs 需 9.4 s，加上每層切削 20 s，每層約 29.4 s，總計約 8.2 小時；8 位元影像共約 3.1 GB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 20 × 20 × 10 µm volume at 10 nm slices is 1000 slices; each 2048 × 1536 SEM image at 3 µs per pixel takes 9.4 s, plus 20 s of milling, about 29.4 s per slice and 8.2 hours in total, with about 3.1 GB of 8-bit images.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切片厚度就等於設定的步距，不需要另外量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slice thickness equals the programmed step and needs no separate measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「切片—成像循環與體素」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「切片—成像循環與體素」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：體積 20 × 20 × 10 µm、切片 10 nm 共 1000 層；每張 SEM 影像 2048 × 1536 像素、每像素 3 µs 需 9.4 s，加上每層切削 20 s，每層約 29.4 s，總計約 8.2 小時；8 位元影像共約 3.1 GB。x 方向像素 20 µm/2048 = 9.8 nm，傾斜 52° 下 y 方向真實尺寸為 9.8/0.788 = 12.4 nm，需重新取樣才得到等向體素。漂移 2 nm/min 在 8.2 小時累積近 1 µm，必須以基準追蹤修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 20 × 20 × 10 µm volume at 10 nm slices is 1000 slices; each 2048 × 1536 SEM image at 3 µs per pixel takes 9.4 s, plus 20 s of milling, about 29.4 s per slice and 8.2 hours in total, with about 3.1 GB of 8-bit images. The x pixel is 20 µm/2048 = 9.8 nm, while at 52° tilt the true y size is 9.8/0.788 = 12.4 nm, so resampling is needed for isotropic voxels. A 2 nm/min drift accumulates nearly 1 µm over 8.2 hours and must be corrected by fiducial tracking. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在體積旁切一對斜向基準線，其在每張截面上的間距變化直接編碼實際切削深度，用來量每層真實厚度並與標稱 10 nm 比較；以已知幾何的結構（如節距已知的接觸孔陣列）重建後量其尺寸驗證三軸比例；整段過程記錄漂移修正量與束流，並在重建前檢查影像亮度與對焦的趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mill a pair of inclined fiducial lines beside the volume whose separation on each face encodes the true milled depth, measuring each slice's real thickness against the nominal 10 nm; reconstruct a structure of known geometry, such as a contact array of known pitch, and measure it to verify the three axis scales; log drift corrections and beam current throughout and check trends in image brightness and focus before reconstruction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

The x pixel is 20 µm/2048 = 9.8 nm, while at 52° tilt the true y size is 9.8/0.788 = 12.4 nm, so resampling is needed for isotropic voxels. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration", which statement holds?
options: 離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。
截面厚度可以直接從 SEM 影像讀出，不必做傾斜修正。
optionsEn: Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current.
Cross-section thickness can be read straight from the SEM image without tilt correction.
A 20 × 20 × 10 µm volume at 10 nm slices is 1000 slices.

steps.title: FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「切片—成像循環與體素」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在體積旁切一對斜向基準線，其在每張截面上的間距變化直接編碼實際切削深度，用來量每層真實厚度並與標稱 10 nm 比較；以已知幾何的結構（如節距已知的接觸孔陣列）重建後量其尺寸驗證三軸比例；整段過程記錄漂移修正量與束流，並在重建前檢查影像亮度與對焦的趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mill a pair of inclined fiducial lines beside the volume whose separation on each face encodes the true milled depth, measuring each slice's real thickness against the nominal 10 nm; reconstruct a structure of known geometry, such as a contact array of known pitch, and measure it to verify the three axis scales; log drift corrections and beam current throughout and check trends in image brightness and focus before reconstruction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤；夜間離子源不穩讓數十層切得過厚，三維模型出現跳層，若沒有基準線就無從發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results; overnight source instability that over-mills tens of slices creates jumps in the 3D model, which cannot be detected without fiducial lines.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration"?
options: 在體積旁切一對斜向基準線，其在每張截面上的間距變化直接編碼實際切削深度，用來量每層真實厚度並與標稱 10 nm 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
薄片越薄越好，表面損傷層對 TEM 分析沒有影響。
optionsEn: Mill a pair of inclined fiducial lines beside the volume whose separation on each face encodes the true milled depth, measuring each slice's real thickness against the nominal 10 nm.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The thinner the lamella the better; surface damage layers do not affect TEM analysis.
quiz.explanation: 在體積旁切一對斜向基準線，其在每張截面上的間距變化直接編碼實際切削深度，用來量每層真實厚度並與標稱 10 nm 比較；以已知幾何的結構（如節距已知的接觸孔陣列）重建後量其尺寸驗證三軸比例；整段過程記錄漂移修正量與束流，並在重建前檢查影像亮度與對焦的趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mill a pair of inclined fiducial lines beside the volume whose separation on each face encodes the true milled depth, measuring each slice's real thickness against the nominal 10 nm; reconstruct a structure of known geometry, such as a contact array of known pitch, and measure it to verify the three axis scales; log drift corrections and beam current throughout and check trends in image brightness and focus before reconstruction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切片—成像循環與體素」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤；夜間離子源不穩讓數十層切得過厚，三維模型出現跳層，若沒有基準線就無從發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results; overnight source instability that over-mills tens of slices creates jumps in the 3D model, which cannot be detected without fiducial lines. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料量與時間預算也必須在開始前算好，否則實驗會在半途因儲存或源壽命而中斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data volume and time budget must be calculated before starting, or the run stops halfway on storage or source life.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「切片厚度就等於設定的步距，不需要另外量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slice thickness equals the programmed step and needs no separate measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤；夜間離子源不穩讓數十層切得過厚，三維模型出現跳層，若沒有基準線就無從發現。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results; overnight source instability that over-mills tens of slices creates jumps in the 3D model, which cannot be detected without fiducial lines.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤。
FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results.
Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever.
quiz.explanation: 未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤；夜間離子源不穩讓數十層切得過厚，三維模型出現跳層，若沒有基準線就無從發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results; overnight source instability that over-mills tens of slices creates jumps in the 3D model, which cannot be detected without fiducial lines. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。交接紀錄須包含光闌束流表、材料切削速率表、源的累計 µA·h 與萃取電壓趨勢、氣體注入系統的沉積參數，以及每種分析流程的標準作業參數，任何一項更新都要重新驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography. The handoff record must hold the aperture-current table, the material milling-rate table, the source's accumulated µA·h and extractor-voltage trend, gas-injection deposition parameters and the standard settings of each analytical workflow, and any update requires re-verification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值；各光闌實測束流與標示差 −8% 到 +4%，全部寫入劑量表後重切矽方塊得 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC，與模型 0.275 相符；共焦點偏差 0.6 µm（允收 ≤ 1 µm）；2 kV 清潔後薄片側壁非晶層 2–3 nm；漂移 1.8 nm/min（允收 ≤ 5 nm/min）；源累計 420 µA·h，以 2.2 µA 計剩約 490 小時。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance; measured aperture currents differ from their labels by −8% to +4%, and after entering them in the dose table a re-milled silicon box gives 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC, consistent with the 0.275 model; coincident-point error is 0.6 µm against an allowance of 1 µm; lamella sidewall amorphous layers after 2 kV cleaning are 2–3 nm; drift is 1.8 nm/min against 5 nm/min; the source has accumulated 420 µA·h, leaving about 490 hours at 2.2 µA.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「系統驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System acceptance and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。
離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。
FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。
optionsEn: Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever.
Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate.

Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography.
quiz.explanation: FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值；各光闌實測束流與標示差 −8% 到 +4%，全部寫入劑量表後重切矽方塊得 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC，與模型 0.275 相符；共焦點偏差 0.6 µm（允收 ≤ 1 µm）；2 kV 清潔後薄片側壁非晶層 2–3 nm；漂移 1.8 nm/min（允收 ≤ 5 nm/min）；源累計 420 µA·h，以 2.2 µA 計剩約 490 小時。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance; measured aperture currents differ from their labels by −8% to +4%, and after entering them in the dose table a re-milled silicon box gives 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC, consistent with the 0.275 model; coincident-point error is 0.6 µm against an allowance of 1 µm; lamella sidewall amorphous layers after 2 kV cleaning are 2–3 nm; drift is 1.8 nm/min against 5 nm/min; the source has accumulated 420 µA·h, leaving about 490 hours at 2.2 µA. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑；每項結果與模型值並列，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把束流表、速率表與流程參數一起交接並設定下次驗證日期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial; enter each result beside its model value, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and finally hand over the current table, rate table and workflow settings together with the next verification date.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值；各光闌實測束流與標示差 −8% 到 +4%，全部寫入劑量表後重切矽方塊得 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC，與模型 0.275 相符；共焦點偏差 0.6 µm（允收 ≤ 1 µm）；2 kV 清潔後薄片側壁非晶層 2–3 nm；漂移 1.8 nm/min（允收 ≤ 5 nm/min）；源累計 420 µA·h，以 2.2 µA 計剩約 490 小時。
knowledge.textEn: Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance; measured aperture currents differ from their labels by −8% to +4%, and after entering them in the dose table a re-milled silicon box gives 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC, consistent with the 0.275 model; coincident-point error is 0.6 µm against an allowance of 1 µm; lamella sidewall amorphous layers after 2 kV cleaning are 2–3 nm; drift is 1.8 nm/min against 5 nm/min; the source has accumulated 420 µA·h, leaving about 490 hours at 2.2 µA.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統驗收與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System acceptance and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值。
FIB 的離子柱和 SEM 一樣使用磁透鏡聚焦。
薄片越薄越好，表面損傷層對 TEM 分析沒有影響。
optionsEn: Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance.
An FIB ion column focuses with magnetic lenses just like an SEM.
The thinner the lamella the better; surface damage layers do not affect TEM analysis.
quiz.explanation: 驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值；各光闌實測束流與標示差 −8% 到 +4%，全部寫入劑量表後重切矽方塊得 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC，與模型 0.275 相符；共焦點偏差 0.6 µm（允收 ≤ 1 µm）；2 kV 清潔後薄片側壁非晶層 2–3 nm；漂移 1.8 nm/min（允收 ≤ 5 nm/min）；源累計 420 µA·h，以 2.2 µA 計剩約 490 小時。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance; measured aperture currents differ from their labels by −8% to +4%, and after entering them in the dose table a re-milled silicon box gives 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC, consistent with the 0.275 model; coincident-point error is 0.6 µm against an allowance of 1 µm; lamella sidewall amorphous layers after 2 kV cleaning are 2–3 nm; drift is 1.8 nm/min against 5 nm/min; the source has accumulated 420 µA·h, leaving about 490 hours at 2.2 µA. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑；每項結果與模型值並列，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把束流表、速率表與流程參數一起交接並設定下次驗證日期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial; enter each result beside its model value, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and finally hand over the current table, rate table and workflow settings together with the next verification date. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時沒有光闌束流表，新使用者依標示值設定劑量，薄片減薄步驟用錯束流而在最後一步切穿；源的萃取電壓趨勢沒有被追蹤，源在關鍵的過夜斷層實驗中途失效，數百層資料無法拼接。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without an aperture-current table at handoff, new users set doses from the labels, choose the wrong current in a thinning step and punch through the lamella at the last step; with no tracking of the extractor-voltage trend the source fails midway through a critical overnight tomography run and hundreds of slices cannot be stitched.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑；每項結果與模型值並列，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把束流表、速率表與流程參數一起交接並設定下次驗證日期。
knowledge.textEn: Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial; enter each result beside its model value, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and finally hand over the current table, rate table and workflow settings together with the next verification date.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑。
光闌標示的束流值就是實際打到樣品上的束流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial.
The current printed on an aperture is the current actually reaching the sample.
quiz.explanation: 依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑；每項結果與模型值並列，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把束流表、速率表與流程參數一起交接並設定下次驗證日期。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial; enter each result beside its model value, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and finally hand over the current table, rate table and workflow settings together with the next verification date. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時沒有光闌束流表，新使用者依標示值設定劑量，薄片減薄步驟用錯束流而在最後一步切穿；源的萃取電壓趨勢沒有被追蹤，源在關鍵的過夜斷層實驗中途失效，數百層資料無法拼接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without an aperture-current table at handoff, new users set doses from the labels, choose the wrong current in a thinning step and punch through the lamella at the last step; with no tracking of the extractor-voltage trend the source fails midway through a critical overnight tomography run and hundreds of slices cannot be stitched. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄須包含光闌束流表、材料切削速率表、源的累計 µA·h 與萃取電壓趨勢、氣體注入系統的沉積參數，以及每種分析流程的標準作業參數，任何一項更新都要重新驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must hold the aperture-current table, the material milling-rate table, the source's accumulated µA·h and extractor-voltage trend, gas-injection deposition parameters and the standard settings of each analytical workflow, and any update requires re-verification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統驗收與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System acceptance and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。
交接時沒有光闌束流表，新使用者依標示值設定劑量，薄片減薄步驟用錯束流而在最後一步切穿。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate.
Without an aperture-current table at handoff, new users set doses from the labels, choose the wrong current in a thinning step and punch through the lamella at the last step.
quiz.explanation: 交接時沒有光闌束流表，新使用者依標示值設定劑量，薄片減薄步驟用錯束流而在最後一步切穿；源的萃取電壓趨勢沒有被追蹤，源在關鍵的過夜斷層實驗中途失效，數百層資料無法拼接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without an aperture-current table at handoff, new users set doses from the labels, choose the wrong current in a thinning step and punch through the lamella at the last step; with no tracking of the extractor-voltage trend the source fails midway through a critical overnight tomography run and hundreds of slices cannot be stitched.
